# NVIDIA GTC 2026 – an opportunity to follow the latest AI developments (EN)

 Post author    By xenya
 Post date    09/03/2026

The NVIDIA GTC 2026 conference will take place March 16–19, 2026 in San Jose, California, with both in-person and online participation options. The event is widely considered one of the most important technical conferences focused on artificial intelligence, accelerated computing, and modern data-center infrastructure. [...] GTC typically brings together developers, researchers, and engineers presenting new work and practical implementations in areas such as:

 generative AI and large-scale models
 GPU-accelerated computing and the CUDA ecosystem
 AI infrastructure and data-center architectures
 robotics, simulation, and digital twins
 applied AI across industries [...] The program usually includes technical talks, tutorials, workshops, and architecture-level discussions. A central highlight of the conference is the keynote by NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang.

Free virtual attendance

For engineers and developers unable to attend in person, NVIDIA provides a free virtual pass. This option enables online registration and access to the live keynote stream as well as selected sessions and on-demand technical content.

title: Nvidia GPUs vs Amazon Trainium for AI: What the Latest Developments Mean for 2026 - AI Tech Model
snippet:
Amazon Trainium is now a credible production-scale alternative to Nvidia GPUs, but neither is the automatic winner for AI workloads in 2026. The right choice depends on model performance, deployment timing, software effort, and whether a team wants to optimize deeply for AWS. Both are accelerators—specialized processors built to train and run machine-learning models. Trainium3 is available today, while Nvidia's Rubin platform is moving from production into partner systems during the second half [...] Each Rubin gpu has 288 GB of HBM4 memory and 22 TB/s of memory bandwidth, according to the Nvidia architecture overview. That timing distinction matters. AWS already sells Trainium3 capacity, but the available evidence does not show Rubin broadly deployed on AWS. Nvidia calls AWS an early Rubin cloud, while AWS describes a future offering subject to availability, timing, and configuration.

## Why specifications do not pick a winner [...] AWS made EC2 Trn3 UltraServers generally available on December 2, 2025. Each system can combine 144 Trainium3 chips for frontier-model training and inference, according to the AWS Trn3 availability announcement. nvidia says Vera Rubin is in full production, with partner products scheduled for the second half of 2026.
